question: what is gen2's absolute vertical level at Elba, measured against its own held-out surveyed checkpoints, and how does it split by canopy?

inputs.role: the 534 surveyed control points of the 2021 3DEP MN_SE_Driftless project with the USGS VATool per-point residuals on the 390 held-out checkpoints
our own estimate_tie result at the six checkpoints whose gen2 point cloud is on disk
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2210_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 3056_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2024_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2036_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2099_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 3089_2021_MN, read per flight line in section 6b

params.name: excluded_from_every_accuracy_statement
params.why: the vendor FGDC metadata says the LCPs calibrated the lidar and the NVA/VVA checkpoints were held out; the LCPs carry no residual at all

params.name: geoid_term_mm
params.why: the control is NAVD88(GEOID18) and gen2 is delivered on NAVD88(GEOID18), so the geoid cancels and no conversion is applied; section 0 asserts this per mark and raises if any mark disagrees

masks.name: laz: role=check
masks.defn: marks the vendor held out of calibration (NVA + VVA); the 143 LCPs carry no residual and are absent from this table entirely

masks.name: dem: role=check
masks.defn: marks the vendor held out of calibration (NVA + VVA); the 143 LCPs carry no residual and are absent from this table entirely

columns.surface: which delivered 2021 surface the residual is against: laz = the classified point cloud, dem = the OPR DEM
columns.block: USGS quality-level block whose products were tested, QL0 or QL1
columns.class: the survey's own accuracy class: NVA non-vegetated, VVA vegetated
columns.mean_mm: mean residual, surveyed minus surface; POSITIVE = the surface reads LOW, mm
columns.median_mm: median of the same residual, mm
columns.sd_mm: sample standard deviation over marks, mm
columns.se_mm: sd/sqrt(n): standard error of THE MEAN OVER THESE MARKS, not the uncertainty of the level at any one place, mm
columns.rmse_mm: root mean square of the residual over these marks, mm
columns.band_km: marks within this distance of the site, cumulative, km
columns.diff_mm: NVA mean minus VVA mean: how much higher the surface reads under vegetation than on open ground, mm
columns.se_diff_mm: standard error of that difference (Welch), mm
columns.t: Welch t statistic of the NVA-VVA difference, dimensionless
columns.variant: which marks and which drift enter the kriging system
columns.max_lag_m: largest separation entering the empirical variogram, m
columns.pred_mm: kriged residual AT THE SITE, mm, sign as above
columns.sd_field_mm: sd of the error in predicting the spatially correlated part of the field at the site, nugget filtered out, mm
columns.sd_mark_mm: sd of the error in predicting what ONE new mark placed at the site would read, nugget included, mm
columns.usgs_mm: USGS VATool residual at the mark, surveyed minus delivered surface, mm
columns.ours_mm: our estimate_tie at the same mark on the same delivered class-2 cloud, surveyed minus lidar, mm
columns.delta_mm: ours minus USGS at the same mark, mm
columns.sigma_mm: half the tie's spread across the pipeline-scale radii, mm
columns.pred_range_mm: min..max of the kriged site value over the whole nuisance grid at this max_lag, mm
columns.line: point_source_id of the 2021 flight line, integer
columns.n_line: class-2 returns of that line inside the box, count

headline: gen2's absolute level at Elba, from its own held-out checkpoints; see sections 2-5.
